headline: Mooring County Ignites as Fierce Clashes Grip Weathered Expanse
war_summary: Since the previous edition, frontline combat has flared sharply in Mooring County, where fresh base exchanges around The Wind Hills accompanied severe casualties. Weathered Expanse remains locked in intense turmoil, logging ongoing territory shifts and heavy losses near Crow's Nest and Wightwalk. In Palantine Berm, the frantic pace of fortification turnover has tempered slightly after extensive fighting across Leiri Hermanni, yet the sector remains contested. Tactical base flips have paused over the past two hours in Nevish Line, Callahan's Passage, and Marban Hollow, though massive attrition persists across Callahan's Passage and Marban Hollow with thousands falling in grinding engagements. Stlican Shelf continues to register steady skirmishing, while the interior rear lines across the north and south remain undisturbed.
